description: This PHP class 'PoolInvestListener' handles investment events related to pool investments within the Goteo project. It manages failed and successful investment processes by logging activities, updating investment status, sending notifications, and redirecting users accordingly.

classes.name: PoolInvestListener
classes.description: A listener class for handling investment success and failure events specific to pool investments, including logging, notifications, status updates, and redirection actions.

methods.name: onInvestFailed
methods.description: Handles the event when a pool investment fails, logs the failure, updates details, and redirects the user to the pool payment page.

methods.name: onInvestSuccess
methods.description: Handles the event when a pool investment succeeds, updates the investment status, recalculates the pool, sends notifications, logs the success, and redirects the user to the pool page.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the array of events this listener subscribes to, namely investment success and failure events.
